source_family_scope: Declared benchmark dataset identities versus all40 selected NI source identities; shared web origins and pretraining contamination are not ruled out.
selection: Before any model score: SHA256(1414/id) order within group, first4 eligible per MMLU subject and first128 per other benchmark; prompt<=512 and no declared text overlap. No answer/performance screening.
text_check: Normalized exact text plus exhaustive inverted-index5-word-shingle Jaccard>=.90 over declared question/full-input/passage fields vs selected NI raw inputs. Fields<5 words excluded from short-fragment check. Does not establish semantic independence or unknown-source absence.

source_download_manifest.purpose: Independent general evaluation candidates only; not training, rewards or selection; selection/audit pending

pretraining_contamination: unknown; no claim of unseen pretraining data
scoring: Fixed zero-shot option-letter conditional likelihood; no CoT; limited subsets, not full benchmark or TRACE replication
